summary: Messaging Center and Order Tracking feature testing complete. Frontend pages (/messages, /orders/:id/tracking) load and function properly with all navigation flows working.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing orders and consultations
context_for_next_testing_agent: Messaging Center and Order Tracking features fully implemented and tested. Key routes: /messages (messaging center), /orders/:id/tracking (order tracking). Key APIs: GET /api/conversations, PUT /api/messages/{id}/read, GET /api/orders/{id}/tracking. Dashboard has Messages button in header and Track/Message buttons in All Orders tab.

Messaging_Center_Route.description: /messages route loads correctly with conversation list and message thread area

Messaging_Center_Conversations_List.description: Displays list of conversations (orders and consultations) with status badges

Messaging_Center_Conversation_Selection.description: Clicking conversation shows message thread area with input and send button

Order_Tracking_Summary.description: Shows order summary with title, status badges (Pending, Paid), amount, date, duration

Order_Tracking_Timeline.description: Shows visual timeline with status progression (Order Placed, Payment Confirmed, Order Accepted, In Progress, Proof Submitted, Completed)

Dashboard_All_Orders_Track_Button.description: Track button in All Orders tab (data-testid='track-order-{id}') navigates to tracking page

Dashboard_All_Orders_Message_Button.description: Message button (MessageSquare icon) in All Orders tab navigates to /messages

API_GET_Conversations.description: GET /api/conversations returns list of user's orders and consultations with unread counts

API_GET_Order_Tracking.description: GET /api/orders/{id}/tracking returns order details with timeline

API_POST_Messages.description: POST /api/messages creates new message for order/consultation
